entries.title: Rare Saps
entries.description: Added Silver, Golden, Diamond and Amethyst Sap with separate owned-amount calculators, three bonuses each and their tree-cutting drop chances.

entries.title: Power of Fossils
entries.description: Added seven permanent Fossil milestone bonuses, including More Life Gems and More Void Apples.

entries.title: Named Sap and Fossil effects
entries.description: Bonus cards now show their real effects, including More Logs, Axe Damage, Better Sap Chance, More Research Cap and Mastery.

entries.title: Fossil calculator input
entries.description: Fixed empty Fossil amounts being rejected; an empty field now correctly behaves as zero, and game-number input is accepted.

entries.title: Bonus card overflow and resource links
entries.description: Fixed cramped text and overflowing bonus cards. Colored resource names in the calculators now navigate to their matching wiki pages.

entries.title: Rare Sap colors and layout
entries.description: Grouped the four Rare Saps on one page, color-coded by type, and adjusted the bonus grids for desktop and mobile screens.

entries.title: A refreshed Update Log
entries.description: Added a version overview, entry counts, category filters and colorful, clickable resource references throughout the release notes.
